nodes.label: Fairy Goose Icon
nodes.description: Black and white pen-and-ink style illustration depicting a small witch or gnome figure riding on the back of a large goose in flight. The rider wears a pointed pilgrim/witch hat and glasses, holds a broomstick aloft, and is dressed in old-fashioned buckled clothing. The goose has wide outstretched wings and faces left. The style is reminiscent of vintage storybook or woodcut engravings. Used as an icon in the GooseOS Win95-style desktop environment.
nodes.style: black and white pen-and-ink / woodcut engraving
